style_notes: Analog 35mm film photography, warm analog film grain structure, heavily muted desaturated palette. Abstract and conceptual — never literal, never illustrative. No people, no faces, no obvious religious iconography. Evoke emotional and theological truth through texture, light, shadow, and negative space alone. Think Alabaster Books meets Kinfolk magazine: spare, intimate, unhurried. Objects minimal or absent. Light does the storytelling. No text, no captions, no inscriptions, no readable letters, no film stock branding, no Kodak or Portra labels, no frame numbers, no aspect ratio markers, no watermarks. No modern objects, no asphalt, no painted road markings, no vehicles, no cars, no motorcycles, no machinery. No human figures, no faces, no body parts, no hands. 1st-century Mediterranean Levantine setting only.
color_palette: Bleached linen, weathered stone, faded terracotta, dry grass, bone white, ash gray, deep shadow — all heavily desaturated with analog film warmth

images.title: Temptation in the Wilderness
images.concept: Spirit-led into the place of testing — the desert that strips everything down to what is real
images.imageAlt: An expanse of cracked dry earth receding to a flat horizon under a bleached white sky, a single small stone in the foreground
images.prompt: 35mm analog film photograph, wide view of cracked dry desert earth stretching to a flat horizon, the surface fractured in irregular geometric patterns, bone white sky at the horizon merging almost tonally with the pale earth, one small dark stone sits in the near foreground right of center, deep film grain especially in the sky, everything bleached and desaturated with only the faintest warm undertone, vast emptiness that is not desolate but intensely present, no people no vegetation no objects beyond the stone, raking side light from the left casting barely perceptible shadows in the earth cracks, Alabaster Books aesthetic, 16:9 landscape, spiritual weight carried entirely by negative space

images.title: Rejection at Nazareth
images.concept: The scroll opened, the words spoken — then a door shut against the one who came home
images.imageAlt: A weathered wooden door frame with the door slightly ajar, harsh midday light cutting through the narrow gap into darkness
images.prompt: 35mm analog film photograph, close study of an ancient weathered wooden door frame, the door standing slightly ajar, a harsh wedge of bright midday light cutting through the narrow gap into the dark interior beyond, the door's surface showing decades of wear, grain raised, paint long gone, the light inside the gap so bright it bleaches to white while the surrounding doorway remains in cool shadow, heavy warm analog film grain throughout, muted palette of ash gray and faded wood tone, no people no text no objects — just the threshold and the light that cannot fully enter, Kinfolk editorial restraint, 16:9 landscape

images.title: Authority over Demons at Capernaum
images.concept: A word spoken — and the disordering force departs, leaving behind uncanny stillness
images.imageAlt: A stone floor with a sharp diagonal shadow line dividing bright from dark, a small pile of dust scattered in the light zone
images.prompt: 35mm analog film photograph, ancient stone floor seen from above, a sharp diagonal line of shadow cutting across the frame dividing half to bright raking light and half to deep shadow, a small scattered disturbance of fine dust or dry particles visible in the illuminated half as if something has just left the space, the stone surface rough and worn, heavy film grain in the shadow half, warm stone tones only slightly desaturated, the absence of whatever was there is the subject, Alabaster Books stillness, 16:9 landscape with the shadow line running lower-left to upper-right

images.title: Healing Simon's Mother-in-law
images.concept: The fever breaks — the body restored to itself, service made possible again
images.imageAlt: Rumpled linen cloth on a low stone surface catching warm afternoon light, the fabric still creased from rest
images.prompt: 35mm analog film photograph, an empty earthenware cup of warm broth resting on a low wooden stool beside a small open window, soft morning light streaming in across the cup and onto the worn floor, faint steam rising from the cup, a folded woven blanket pushed neatly to one side as if just risen from, no figure, no body shape, fine warm analog film grain, muted palette of pale clay, light wood, golden morning light, Kinfolk magazine stillness, 16:9 landscape, the moment of restoration evidenced by someone newly up and serving.

images.title: Departure to Other Towns
images.concept: The mission is not to stay — compelled onward toward those who have not yet heard
images.imageAlt: A dusty road disappearing into pale morning haze, the road's surface lit from behind, everything ahead dissolved in soft light
images.prompt: 35mm analog film photograph, a narrow stone and dust road receding into soft pale morning haze at the horizon, the road surface lit from behind by low backlight turning the dust particles luminous, the edges of the road dissolving into dry grass and pale soil, everything ahead overexposed in soft white-gold light, the destination invisible, heavy film grain in the foreground shadows, muted terracotta and bleached white palette, no people no vehicles — just the road and the light ahead, Alabaster Books aesthetic, 16:9 with the road centered receding into upper middle of frame
